insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Star Health And Allied Insurance Co Ltd.

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments up to 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern/day-care procedures capped at 50% SI; road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; waived if prior continuous coverage exceeds 12 months

ped_waiting.note: Only PEDs declared and accepted by insurer are covered after 36 months; no optional reduction available

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list: benign ENT, tonsillectomy, adenoidectomy, mastoidectomy, tympanoplasty, hysterectomy, benign tumours/cysts, BPH, cataract, gastric ulcer, gout, hernia, hydrocele, non-infective arthritis, piles/fissures/fistula, pilonidal sinus/sinusitis, prolapsed IVD, calculi, varicose veins, internal congenital anomalies. 36-month list: joint replacement, age-related osteoarthritis & osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: For same condition as hospitalisation; inpatient claim must be admissible

post_hosp.note: For same condition as hospitalisation; inpatient claim must be admissible

day_care.note: All day-care treatments listed as covered; listed modern procedures also covered as day-care up to 50% SI

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 21

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure-A List I; no consumables rider available

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period for enhanced portion

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, moratorium transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, sterility/infertility, treatment outside India, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack, permanent exclusions per schedule

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
